name: watchtower
_note: Covers both entry modes (daily/weekly) with checks true regardless of mode. The pre-publish-review guardrail checkpoint only fires inside weekly-step-06, which is itself optional (David can skip it) — it is intentionally NOT a hard assertion here, since that would produce false failures on every daily run and on weekly runs where step-06 was skipped. Its result is still recorded in the eval record's guardrails array whenever it does run; verify it there directly rather than via this file when auditing a specific weekly-publish run. The adversarial-verification checkpoint (watch-005) is recorded by the weekly run's terminal step (weekly-step-07); it is expected to be absent on daily-only records, so on a daily record it reads as a legitimate 'weekly verification did not run' signal rather than a daily-run failure. Weekly-run records (name watchtower-weekly) carry the mode-correct copy in watchtower-weekly.json.

Read from the eval record's own guardrails array. Weekly-only: a daily-mode record legitimately lacks it (see the _note above).
